name: Field-Route-Optimization-Site-Verification-System
description: Mobile-first field route optimization & site verification: CSV/Excel import, optimized routes, turn-by-turn guidance, GPS-verified check-ins, checklists, photos, offline PWA and PDF reports. React + Supabase.

paragraphs: Plan smarter routes. Verify every site. RouteOps is a mobile-first web app for field teams: import a list of sites, get the fastest visiting order, drive it with turn-by-turn voice guidance, and prove every visit with GPS-verified check-ins, checklists and photos, even without signal.
features: Import sites from CSV or Excel: column names are guessed, South African decimal commas and degree-minute-second coordinates are read correctly, and swapped latitude/longitude is detected with a one-tap fix.
Review on a map before saving: sites outside South Africa and unreadable rows are flagged.
Route optimization via OpenRouteService (up to 70 stops), with a local nearest-neighbour fallback so a routing outage never leaves a driver without a plan.
Driver mode: full-screen map, large turn-by-turn instructions, spoken guidance and arrival alerts.
Field-grade GPS: jumpy fixes are filtered out; going off route recalculates from where you actually are.

whatItDoes.text: Plan smarter routes. Verify every site. RouteOps is a mobile-first web app for field teams: import a list of sites, get the fastest visiting order, drive it with turn-by-turn voice guidance, and prove every visit with GPS-verified check-ins, checklists and photos, even without signal.
